_comment: Written to <filesDir>/.radicle/config.json by RadicleNodePlugin.start() on every launch; {{ALIAS}} is substituted. The phone only saves its own profile: no inbound listen, one outbound link to the OCI seed, seeding default 'block' so only the profiles RID passed to start() (scope 'followed') replicates. preferredSeeds is empty because the runtime appends it to node.connect, and the OCI seed is already there.
